purpose: Requirements for ToC management: information held in the ToC, AI-generated field limits, change detection by content hash, ToC build and rebuild, update planning, candidate verification and acceptance criteria.
summary: ToC information requirements: document info, section entries and reference entries
Limits for AI-generated fields: description limit L and internal tolerance H = floor(L x 1.3) kept hidden from the generator
Change detection against the existing ToC: new, body change, reference change, move or rename, departure, unchanged
Content hash definition: SHA-256 of the original text excluding the title of formal references, and when reflected hashes are updated
ToC build and rebuild procedure with ID confirmation, change detection and information update
Generation of AI fields only for changed documents, reusing existing information otherwise
Reference relation and check status reconstruction from searching referenced directories
ToC candidate verification and atomic confirmation, keeping the last good ToC on failure
Acceptance criteria AC-001 to AC-027 for move, rebuild, failure and change sets
tasks: Designing or implementing the ToC data model
Implementing change detection and hash comparison
Implementing AI field generation and limit validation
Implementing reference extraction and reverse reference generation
Writing tests for ToC acceptance criteria
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
